locations.quote: Motivation/Objective: **Since some Version Control (VC) systems include a Continuous Integration (CI) application, it is possible to reduce the effort required to maintain the servers and migrate the CI service from external applications as Jenkins to the inbuilt CI service.**

Problem Statement: **The interactive learning platform Artemis currently only supports setups with an external CI server. The CI server should be migrated to the VC server. Furthermore, it should be possible to adjust the build plan after the task has been assigned.**

Proposed Solution: **GitLab CI is the CI system provided by the GitLab VC server. This system supports the provision of the build plan via the Artemis API, which makes it possible to update the build plan retrospectively, as the build plan is fetched from the API on each run.**

(Expected) Results: **We expect to use the bridge pattern to dynamically bind Artemis to the concrete implementation with GitLab CI. The reduction in server load will mean that more universities, especially smaller ones with less capacity, will choose Artemis.**
